C1211.title: Amir Hossein Golshan Sentenced to 8 Years for SIM Swapping Fraud
C1211.summary: Amir Hossein Golshan, 25, was sentenced to 8 years in prison by U.S. District Judge Otis D. Wright II for orchestrating a series of SIM swapping scams and fraud schemes, and was ordered to pay over $1.21 million in restitution. The sentence reflects the judiciary's aggressive stance against SIM swapping crimes.
